claims.statement: On Hardcore Worlds, dying to Koschei's first, second or third form is an unsafe (run-ending) death. The official rules list only the 4th phase of the Koschei duel as safe. The wiki's note that forms 1-3 are safe applies to regular Hardcore Ironmen, not to the Hardcore Group Ironman ruleset that Hardcore Worlds uses.

claims.subject: Koschei the deathless (The Fremennik Trials)
claims.statement: Koschei's max hits are 3 / 5 / 7 for forms 1-3, each attacking every 4 ticks (2.4 s). The 4th form's max hit really is 1, not a data error: it hits for 1 every game tick (0.6 s), up to 100 damage a minute, and has 255 Hitpoints. Two wiki pages agree on this.

sources.title: Koschei the deathless
sources.quote: His max hits are 3 in his first form, 5 in his second, and 7 in his third.

sources.title: Koschei the deathless
sources.quote: When he hits, he always hits for 1 [[Hitpoint]], but at a rate of 1 hit every 0.6 seconds

sources.title: Koschei the deathless
sources.quote: *He is the fastest attacking [[NPC]] in the game (in his final form with an attack speed of 1, meaning every 0.6 seconds), along with [[Scarab swarm]]s. The attack speed for his first three forms is 4 (2.4 seconds), the same as unarmed combat.

sources.title: The Fremennik Trials
sources.quote: The fourth form is the hardest. He will hit once every game tick, but can only hit for 1 damage at a time.

claims.notes: Infobox rows (rev 15387641): form 1 '|max hit = 3' '|attack style = [[Slash]]' '|attack speed = 4' '|hitpoints = 30'; form 2 max hit 5, Melee, speed 4, HP 50; form 3 max hit 7, Melee, speed 4, HP 70; form 4 max hit 1, Melee, speed 1, HP 255, att 255. Computed: 1 damage x 100 ticks per minute = up to 100 damage per minute in form 4 (rate x time; accuracy not modelled, and Koschei's Attack is 255 against the owner's Defence 1). One sentence on the Koschei page ('in his third and fourth form he hits progressively harder and quicker') does not match the infobox; the infobox and both strategy passages give 1. The wiki's stat-derived combat levels are 25/48/71/212.

claims.subject: Koschei the deathless, form 4
claims.statement: When Koschei's 4th form starts he drains all your prayer points, then keeps draining 1-2 points every second. Protection prayers cannot be relied on in form 4.

sources.title: The Fremennik Trials
sources.quote: In this form, Koschei will quickly drop your prayer points in intervals of 1-2 every second and will drop all of your prayer points as soon as the form starts.

claims.notes: Only one source. The Koschei page's change log (6 Feb 2014) says Koschei now keeps prayer drained, which supports this.

claims.statement: The Koschei fight is in an instance below Thorvald's house, with no weapons, armour or runes allowed. Food, Prayer and jewellery are allowed. A ring of life will pull you out to your respawn point and reset the fight. If you stay over 10 minutes in one phase, Koschei despawns and the fight restarts. Whether normal teleports work in the arena is not documented.

sources.quote: * As his fight is in an instance, it is possible to return to the instance before it closes to continue the fight from where you left off.

sources.title: The Fremennik Trials
sources.quote: # You cannot use any [[weapons]], [[armour]], [[fletching]] materials (such as [[logs]]/[[arrowtips]]), or bring [[runes]]. The Ardougne cloak counts as armour, but the boots of lightness do not. However, you can use [[food]], [[Prayer]], [[god book]]s, and jewellery.

sources.title: The Fremennik Trials
sources.quote: * Do not wear a [[ring of life]] as you will be teleported back to your spawn point. You will need to fight him again at his first phase.

sources.title: Koschei the deathless
sources.quote: Additionally, if you take too long fighting Koschei (10 minutes in the same phase), he will simply disappear and you will have to start the challenge all over again.

claims.subject: The Fremennik Trials: Koschei fight arena
claims.value: Koschei can be trapped on the far side of a chasm or by the pillars of fire to regenerate. Staying too long makes him reset to form 1. He can be flinched at the torches.
claims.statement: There is no attack safespot for Koschei (you have no weapons), but you can trap him on the other side of a hole in the floor or by the fire pillars and wait to regenerate. Staying too long makes him disappear and reset to form 1. He can also be flinched from the north or south tile of a torch.

sources.title: The Fremennik Trials
sources.quote: There is no way to safespot him as you have no weapons, but you can trap him over the hole and wait a while for your health to regenerate. However, if you stay there too long, he will disappear and reappear after you run around, back in his first form.

sources.title: Koschei the deathless
sources.quote: There are certain [[safespots]] in Koschei's basement, such as the pillars of fire, or the many chasms in the ground.

claims.statement: The Mercenary Captain is level 47, max hit 5 (Slash), 80 HP. He attacks as soon as the dialogue ends, outside the Desert Mining Camp. He can be safespotted by talking to a mercenary so that it blocks his path; the guide also says Protect from Melee lets you take no damage. claims.subject: Monkey Madness I (Chapters 1-2): Ape Atoll arrival and jail

value.gate_archers: volley of poisoned arrows near the Ape Atoll gate
value.teleport: teleporting out is allowed (the guide recommends it)

claims.statement: In Monkey Madness I Chapter 2, the Ape Atoll jail guards punch for 10-20 if you stand in their range. Near the gate you are pelted with poisoned arrows, and the route passes poisonous snakes, scorpions and jungle spiders. Dropping into the cavern under the dentures crate deals 32.9% of your current HP, which Agility can negate. The guide repeatedly recommends teleporting out, so teleports work on the Atoll.

Monkey Archers are level 86, max hit 20 (Ranged), 50 HP, and aggressive unless you hold a monkey greegree. They do not fire while you are in the tall grass. Maniacal monkeys also drop the small bones, and Duke, Oipuis, Padulah, Uodai and Ouhai drop medium ninja bones.

gaps: Whether normal teleports work inside the Koschei arena, the Troll arena (Dad, Arrg), the Recruitment Drive testing grounds or the Crabclaw Caves instance is not documented on the pages read. Only the Recruitment Drive portal, the ring of life (Koschei), Underground Pass, Isafdar after the items, the Tourist Trap jail and Ape Atoll are documented as escapable by teleport.
Whether the Arrg fight is instanced is not stated. The Troll arena page mentions an instance only for the drink-troll fight.
Creature of Fenkenstrain's 'level 72 monsters' to run past are not named in the quest walkthrough.
Skeleton (Ape Atoll) max hit conflicts: 10 (infobox) vs 12 (MM1 quest guide). Unresolved.
Twig's max hit is marked '(approx)' on the wiki.
No T1 source covers the extra safe items on the wiki's Hardcore Worlds page (boat capsizing, Emir's Arena, Pete Kayer's Challenges, Galvek/Glough replays). They stay UNSAFE by policy.
Damage from Klenter's Pyramid wall crushers (Icthlarin's Little Helper), from the stepping stones in the Crabclaw Caves, and from Isafdar monsters was not quantified.
Stats of the medium ninja monkeys (Duke, Oipuis, Padulah, Uodai, Ouhai) and of Maniacal monkeys were not researched; Monkey Archer is assumed to be the practical ninja-bone source.
Adala and Naiatli (Death on the Isle) max hits were not researched; the wiki says the fights cannot kill.
No independent T3 second source was gathered for any max hit. All NPC numbers are wiki infobox values plus the quest walkthroughs on the same wiki.
Disconnect behaviour in these quest fights was not researched beyond the general 60-second in-combat rule (C-THR-021).

decisions.decision: Classify Koschei forms 1-3, Arrg and Sir Leye as UNSAFE_DEATH
decisions.reason: The T1 Hardcore Worlds rules give a closed list of safe exceptions, and only Koschei's 4th phase is on it. The charter defaults to UNSAFE without a T1 safe source. Wiki statements that forms 1-3 are safe refer to regular HCIM.
alternatives_considered: Follow the wiki quest page's 'safe death' wording for forms 1-3 (rejected: HCIM, not HCGIM)

decisions.decision: Report Koschei's 4th-form max hit as 1 (correct), not an error
decisions.reason: The infobox, the strategy text and the Fremennik Trials walkthrough all agree on 1 damage per hit at attack speed 1. The danger is the rate (up to 100/min) and the prayer drain, which is now in the claim.
alternatives_considered: Flag the value as anomalous (rejected: three independent passages agree)

decisions.decision: Use the Monkey Archer as the ninja monkey for the greegree
decisions.reason: The Small ninja monkey bones page names Monkey Archers and Maniacal monkeys; Monkey Archers are the ones on Ape Atoll during Chapter 2.
alternatives_considered: Medium ninja monkeys (Duke etc.; stats not researched)

decisions.decision: Record the skeleton max-hit conflict (10 vs 12) instead of choosing one value
decisions.reason: Two wiki pages disagree; the Risk Officer should apply the conservative 12.

decisions.decision: Note that Barbarian Assault is a Kandarin hard diary task, not an elite Ardougne one
decisions.reason: The quest desk's own sourced claims C-QST-257 and C-QST-266 say so; the classification is unaffected.

limitations: All game data is from the OSRS Wiki (T2) and wiki copies of Jagex posts (T1). No T3 second source was used.
Hardcore Worlds launched on 4 Nov 2026 and The Writing's on the Wall on 3 Nov 2026, both under 30 days ago, so the rules and pages are volatile.
Teleport and instance behaviour is reported only where a page states it; absence of a statement is recorded as 'not documented', not as 'allowed'.
I give evidence only and do not score danger; ratings belong to the Risk Officer.
